strategy.offer: Machines, systems, supplies, service, and training for print finishing, enhancement, booklet making, binding, cutting, folding, and inline postpress automation.
strategy.customers: Digital and offset printers seeking efficient production of brochures, books, and other finished print products, including short runs and variable jobs.
strategy.why_we_win: It promises faster setup, fewer manual steps, reliable quality, broad format flexibility, and workflow integration that reduces waste, labor, and turnaround time.
strategy.resources: Broad postpress portfolio, modular systems, automation features, service technicians, maintenance packages, consumables, spare parts, training, and practical application know-how.
strategy.direction: Advancing toward more automated, software-connected, digitally oriented finishing workflows spanning prepress to finished product across inline and nearline production.
